t2.title: Students take a gap year before starting university
t2.prompt: A student magazine announced an article writing contest. The best ones will be published in the magazine. Write your article on this topic: "Should students take a gap year before starting university?" Write 180–200 words, giving reasons and examples.
t2.sample:
The Wedding Venue Dilemma

With wedding costs continually rising, many couples face the question: splurge on a dream venue or keep things simple? Here's my perspective.

Firstly, expensive venues often provide comprehensive packages – catering, decorations, and coordination included. This can actually reduce stress and sometimes save money overall.

Moreover, a beautiful venue creates lasting memories and stunning photographs that couples treasure for decades.

However, an intimate celebration has its own charm. Many couples find that smaller gatherings feel more meaningful and personal.

Additionally, starting married life with financial pressure from wedding debt can strain relationships. Investing in a home or honeymoon might be wiser.

Ultimately, there's no right answer. What matters is that the celebration reflects the couple's values. Whether in a grand ballroom or a backyard, genuine love is what makes weddings special.

What type of wedding would you choose?
t2.sampleA1:
Hi Rosewood!

Wedding good. Food good. Staff okay.

More flowers?

Bye
t2.sampleA2:
Hello Rosewood Gardens,

The wedding was fun. The food was good, and the garden was pretty. But the music was too loud, and the chairs were not very comfortable.

Maybe you can have quieter music and better chairs next time. Thank you.

Bye!
t2.sampleB1:
Dear Rosewood Gardens Management,

I recently attended a wedding at your venue and wanted to provide some feedback. Overall, I enjoyed the event. The gardens are lovely, and the location is convenient.

The catering was generally good, although the vegetarian options were limited. I think it would be better to have more choices for vegetarians.

The staff were mostly helpful, but sometimes difficult to find. Perhaps more staff could be available during peak times.

In my opinion, improving the vegetarian options and increasing staff availability would enhance the guest experience. Thank you for the opportunity to share my thoughts.

Sincerely,
t2.sampleB2:
Gap Year: A Detour Worth Taking?

Every year, thousands of school-leavers face the same big decision: should they head straight to university, or take a year out first? It is a question worth thinking about carefully. On the plus side, a gap year can be a real eye-opener. Travelling, volunteering or working gives young people the chance to grow up, pick up new skills and figure out what they really want to study. Many come back far more focused and motivated, which pays off in their studies later on. On the other hand, there are risks. Some people lose momentum and never make it back to the classroom. A gap year can also be pricey, and not every family can afford one. In my view, the key is having a clear plan. A year spent lying on the sofa is a waste of time, but one packed with meaningful experiences can set you up for life. So, should students take a gap year? If they use it wisely, absolutely. Sometimes the best way forward is to take a step back first. What do you think?
t2.uzSample:
To'y o'tkazish joyi dilemmasi

To'y xarajatlari doimiy ravishda oshib borayotganligi sababli, ko'plab juftliklar savolga duch kelishadi: orzudagi joyga pul sarflash kerakmi yoki oddiyroq qilish kerakmi? Mana mening nuqtai nazarim.

Birinchidan, qimmatbaho joylar ko'pincha keng qamrovli paketlarni taqdim etadi – ovqatlanish, bezaklar va muvofiqlashtirish shu jumlasidan. Bu aslida stressni kamaytirishi va ba'zan umuman pulni tejashi mumkin.

Bundan tashqari, chiroyli joy uzoq muddatli xotiralar va juftliklar o'nlab yillar davomida qadrlaydigan ajoyib fotosuratlarni yaratadi.

Biroq, samimiy nishonlashning o'ziga xos jozibasi bor. Ko'pgina juftliklar kichikroq yig'ilishlar yanada mazmunli va shaxsiy ekanligini aniqlaydilar.

Bundan tashqari, to'y qarzidan kelib chiqadigan moliyaviy bosim bilan turmush hayotini boshlash munosabatlarga putur yetkazishi mumkin. Uyga yoki asal oyiga sarmoya kiritish oqilonaroq bo'lishi mumkin.

Oxir oqibat, to'g'ri javob yo'q. Muhimi, nishonlash juftlikning qadriyatlarini aks ettirishi kerak. Dabdabali zalda bo'ladimi yoki hovlida, chin muhabbat to'ylarni o'zgacha qiladi.

Siz qanday to'yni tanlagan bo'lardingiz?
t2.uzSampleA1:
Salom, Rosewood!

To'y yaxshi. Ovqat yaxshi. Xodimlar o'rtacha.

Ko'proq gullar kerakmi?

Xayr
t2.uzSampleA2:
Salom, Rosewood Gardens,

To'y qiziqarli bo'ldi. Ovqat yaxshi edi, bog' ham chiroyli. Lekin musiqa juda baland edi, stullar esa unchalik qulay emasdi.

Balki keyingi safar tinchroq musiqa va yaxshiroq stullar bo'lishi mumkin. Rahmat.

Xayr!
t2.uzSampleB1:
Hurmatli Rosewood Gardens rahbariyati,

Yaqinda sizning joyingizda bo'lib o'tgan to'yda qatnashdim va ba'zi fikr-mulohazalarimni bildirishni xohladim. Umuman olganda, tadbir menga yoqdi. Bog'lar juda chiroyli va joylashuvi qulay.

Ovqatlanish asosan yaxshi edi, lekin vegetarianlar uchun tanlovlar cheklangan edi. O'ylaymanki, vegetarianlar uchun ko'proq tanlov bo'lishi yaxshiroq bo'lardi.

Xodimlar asosan yordam berishdi, lekin ba'zan ularni topish qiyin edi. Ehtimol, eng gavjum vaqtlarda ko'proq xodimlar bo'lishi mumkin.

Mening fikrimcha, vegetarian taomlarini yaxshilash va xodimlarning mavjudligini oshirish mehmonlarning tajribasini yaxshilaydi. Fikrlarimni baham ko'rish imkoniyati uchun rahmat.

Hurmat bilan,
t2.uzSampleB2:
Hurmatli Rosewood Gardens rahbariyati,

Men sizning maskaningizda bo'lib o'tgan to'yda qatnashganim haqida fikr-mulohazalarimni bildirish uchun yozyapman. Tadbir umuman olganda yoqimli bo'lgan bo'lsa-da, mehmonlarning tajribasini yanada yaxshilash uchun takomillashtirish mumkin bo'lgan sohalar bor, deb hisoblayman.

Maskanning o'zi estetik jihatdan yoqimli va bog'lar chiroyli fon yaratadi. Biroq, asosiy zalda ovoz tizimi biroz yetarli emas edi, bu nutqlarni aniq eshitishda qiyinchiliklarga olib keldi. Yuqori sifatli audio uskunalari foydali bo'ladi.

Ovqatlanishga kelsak, taomlarning sifati maqtovga loyiq edi, ammo xizmat ko'rsatish ba'zan sekin edi, ayniqsa asosiy taom paytida. Xizmat ko'rsatish jarayonini soddalashtirish bu muammoni hal qilishi mumkin.

Bundan tashqari, xodimlar xushmuomala bo'lishiga qaramay, ularning maskanning joylashuvi va imkoniyatlari haqidagi bilimlari cheklangan ko'rinardi. Xodimlarni yanada keng qamrovli o'qitish ularning mehmonlarga samarali yordam berishini ta'minlaydi. Ushbu takomillashtirishlarga sarmoya kiritish, shubhasiz, Rosewood Gardensni yanada yuqori darajaga ko'taradi.

Hurmat bilan,

t12.title: formal letter · to recipient
t12.prompt: Write a letter to the venue management. Write about your feelings and what you think they should do.
t12.sample:
Dear Rosewood Gardens Management,

I recently attended a wedding at your venue and wish to share my impressions.

Firstly, the venue setting was breathtakingly beautiful. The landscaped gardens provided a stunning backdrop for photographs.

Moreover, the catering service was exceptional. The food was delicious and served promptly.

However, I noticed some areas for improvement. The parking facilities were somewhat limited, causing inconvenience for guests.

Additionally, providing clear signage to different areas of the venue would help guests navigate more easily.

Furthermore, offering weather contingency options for outdoor events would give couples peace of mind.

Thank you for hosting such a memorable celebration.

Warm regards,
A Wedding Guest
t12.sampleA1:
Hi Rosewood Gardens,


Wedding was good. Garden is nice. Food ok. Staff ok.


Bye.
t12.sampleA2:
Dear Rosewood Gardens,


I went to a wedding. The garden is very pretty and the food was good. But the parking was not good. It was too small. Also, I couldn't find the bathroom. Maybe you can put up signs? The staff were nice and helpful.


Thank you,
A Guest
t12.sampleB1:
Dear Rosewood Gardens Management,


I am writing to you about a wedding I went to at your venue. I thought the gardens were very beautiful, and it was a nice place for a wedding. The food was also good, and I enjoyed the meal.


However, I think there are some things you could improve. For example, the parking was a bit difficult, and it was hard to find a space. Also, maybe some more signs would be helpful so people can find their way around. The staff were friendly and helpful though.


Overall, it was a good experience, but these improvements would make it even better.


Sincerely,
A Guest
t12.sampleB2: Dear Rosewood Gardens Management, I am writing to share my thoughts after attending a wedding at your venue last weekend. On the whole, I had a wonderful time. The landscaped gardens looked absolutely stunning and made a perfect backdrop for the photographs. The catering was first-class too, and the dishes were served promptly. That said, there are a couple of things you might want to look into. The parking area filled up quickly, which left several guests circling for a space. In addition, clearer signage would help guests find the restrooms and the bar without having to ask. Sorting out these small issues would go a long way towards making future events run more smoothly. Thank you for a truly memorable celebration. Yours sincerely, Bekzod Aliyev
